issues.reason: A multi-word name states its kind 'in one ordinary type atom instead — whether the kind word sits inside the name or beside it', with 'the Kestrel River' giving (Member kestrel_river river), so 'Sunken Cove' owes (Member sunken_cove cove) and the parse leaves the named referent untyped.

gaps_confirmed: Bare 'when P, Q' with definite/specific participants stating a habitual regularity: the instruction set routes generic/indefinite participants to the whenever rule and definite participants in a one-off narrative to two plain ordered events, and names no form for this in-between case (the parse improvises a ground Implication over constants, with no occurrence variable for a Skolem consequent or a During link to key on).

A bare, non-deictic season adjunct ('in winter'): the structured Time terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute, the bare-symbol cases named are day-parts and deictic season constants (last_spring / next_summer), and no clause states the form for a plain season name — the parse's (Time e winter) is an inference from the day-part precedent, not a stated route.

The Name-only plural rule for a capitalized plural kind-word label fires on a label 'referring as a name', a trigger left undefined — and it is undefined in exactly the case where the label word genuinely does state the members' kind, as 'the Keepers' does.
defect_summary: The compliant form adds (Member sunken_cove cove) beside the existing (Name sunken_cove "Sunken Cove"), the whole name staying one opaque symbol with no modifier genus.
notes: Beyond the confirmed issue, the parse's (GroupOf sk_keeper_1 keeper) with no Name atom for 'the Keepers' is itself a violation of the capitalized-plural-label clause rather than mere gap territory, and a re-parse should fix it alongside the Sunken Cove typing. Otherwise the Northgate-premodifier route, the LocatedIn containment at the Watch, the surface-form Manner adverb, and the non-assertion of both the antecedent property and the consequent are all correct.
